## Requirements in full

### FXR-F-MODEL: The model is the specification: it equals integer arithmetic

- Kind: functional; state: verified; specification status: draft.
- Source: `arith/fxp_round/spec.md#the-function`
- For the rounding and saturation: the three rounding modes equal their definitions on exact fractions for every x, S and W_IN up to 9, the single-adder carry-in form equals the definition for every x, S and mode up to W_IN = 10, the error bounds hold, and saturation and wrap are as specified.
  - simulation test: **pass**, Model tests against Python integer arithmetic: 6 test(s) passed in the recorded run. [evidence](../../../results/139b_arith/fxp_round_junit.xml)

### FXR-F-RTL-EXH: Every variant is bit-exact against the model, exhaustively at small widths

- Kind: functional; state: verified; specification status: draft.

- Simulation (Icarus 14) of every variant against the model: every input x at W_IN = 5 and 8 for every S, four W_OUT around the rounded width, three modes, wrap and saturate: 954 configurations over the three variants.
  - simulation test: **pass**, Exhaustive small widths, every variant: 1 test(s) passed in the recorded run. [evidence](../../../results/139b_arith/fxp_round_junit.xml)

### FXR-F-LEAN-CONV: Convergent rounding: carry-in form, error bound and tie-to-even for every S (Lean)

- Kind: functional; state: proved, statement not approved; specification status: draft.
- Source: `arith/fxp_round/spec.md#verification-everything-before-vivado`
- Convergent rounding computed by one addition of the constant 2^(S-1) - 1 and the result's LSB as a carry-in (what fxp_round_fold builds) equals the textbook definition for every integer x and every S >= 1; its error is at most half a unit; a tie goes to the even result. Proved in Lean, statements not approved. Saturation and wrap are not in the Lean model.
  - Lean proof (all widths): **statement not approved**, The carry-in form of convergent rounding equals its definition, every x and every S >= 1: statement not approved; Arith.Rounding.convFold_eq: kernel only; proof of the transcription, transcription tested; recorded build (not re-run). [evidence](../../../formal/lean/records/build_record.json)
  - Lean proof (all widths): **statement not approved**, Convergent rounding errs by at most half a unit, every x and S: statement not approved; Arith.Rounding.convergent_error: kernel only; proof of a model, no RTL link; recorded build (not re-run). [evidence](../../../formal/lean/records/build_record.json)
  - Lean proof (all widths): **statement not approved**, A convergent tie rounds to an even result, every x and S: statement not approved; Arith.Rounding.convergent_tie_even: kernel only; proof of a model, no RTL link; recorded build (not re-run). [evidence](../../../formal/lean/records/build_record.json)

### FXR-F-LEAN-HALFUP: Round half up and truncation: definition and error bounds for every S (Lean)

- Kind: functional; state: proved, statement not approved; specification status: draft.
- Source: `arith/fxp_round/spec.md#verification-everything-before-vivado`
- Round half up is floor + [fraction >= half] and errs by at most half a unit; truncation errs by less than one unit and never upward; every x, every S >= 1. Proved in Lean, statements not approved; pure arithmetic, no RTL link.
  - Lean proof (all widths): **statement not approved**, Round half up is the floor plus one exactly when the fraction is at least the half: statement not approved; Arith.Rounding.halfUp_def: kernel only; proof of a model, no RTL link; recorded build (not re-run). [evidence](../../../formal/lean/records/build_record.json)
  - Lean proof (all widths): **statement not approved**, Round half up errs by at most half a unit (and strictly less on the low side), every x and S: statement not approved; Arith.Rounding.halfUp_error: kernel only; proof of a model, no RTL link; recorded build (not re-run). [evidence](../../../formal/lean/records/build_record.json)
  - Lean proof (all widths): **statement not approved**, Truncation errs by less than one unit and never upward, every x and S: statement not approved; Arith.Rounding.trunc_error: kernel only; proof of a model, no RTL link; recorded build (not re-run). [evidence](../../../formal/lean/records/build_record.json)
